column1: # §4.7 — `/File Import Numbers` runs on a background tokio task.
# Mid-flight the user sees WAIT mode + an "Importing <basename>"
# hint on line 3; cells aren't populated until the worker completes.
# Park the next async op so the transcript can observe pre-spawn
# WAIT state. In production any /FIN above one render-tick lands
# /FIN <path><Enter> — queues the import and returns immediately.
# Mid-flight: WAIT indicator is visible, line 3 names the file
# being imported, and no cells have been populated yet.
# Drain the parked op to completion.
